mostWorthwhile.text: Combining insulin with the muscle was worthwhile because it showed that insulin is a message, not part of the stored carbohydrate.

leastWorthwhile.text: Releasing the second pancreatic message felt a little repetitive after the insulin release, though it set up the other route.

surprise.text: I found it helpful that insulin stays outside the muscle cells while glucose becomes part of the store.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained both hormone pairings.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how these different body systems connect, although this chapter's pairings were fairly predictable.
